$comment: Bram the smith, by the forge. Sells tonics.
speaker: Bram

hello.text: Forge is cold, so I'm not forging. I'm brewing. Ember tonic: pepper, honey and something I won't tell you. Puts heart back in you.

blade.text: That's Dorran's old blade on your back. I re-edged it for him years ago. Hits like a falling anvil. Treat it nicely.

advice.text: Drinking takes a moment, so don't do it with a skeleton in your face. Back off, or wait till it's swung and missed. Same goes for everything, really.

after.text: Forge is lit! First time in a month. I'll make you something proper one day. Tonics are still for sale, mind.
